node.statement: PRH square-root sharpness: for every 0 < lambda < 1/2 there are positive unital maps A:l-infinity(2)->l-infinity(4) and M:l-infinity(4)->l-infinity(2) with epsilon_lambda=||MA-I_2||_{infinity->infinity}=2*lambda^2 tending to 0 such that every stochastic idempotent F on l-infinity(4) satisfies ||AM-F||_{infinity->infinity} >= lambda=sqrt(epsilon_lambda/2); hence the sqrt(epsilon) order in PRH is intrinsically sharp.
